hypothesis: Chop-regime PnL sensitivity is sleeve-specific; attributing every accepted default-off sleeve identifies the subset a chop-scoped soft down-tilt should cover and which it must exclude.
changed_variable: read-only entry-day regime_chop_state attribution of all 8 accepted default-off candidate-pool sleeve replay trades across the three fixed windows
interpretation: Every accepted default-off candidate-pool sleeve EXCEPT the core-flow-confirmed industry_stable_core_flow shares the FGRS chop-loss, confirming chop-sensitivity is a property of standalone candidate-pool sleeves, not the portfolio. Pooled Spearman(p_choppy,pnl): fiftytwo_week_high_proximity -0.298 (n=54), supplier_financing_debt_relief -0.232 (n=88), sbc_burden_improvement -0.227 (n=108), distribution_day_absorption_leadership -0.126 (n=113), turn_of_month_liquid_leadership -0.122 (n=73); near-zero/positive: narrow_range_compression_breakout -0.023 (n=44, only 2 chop trades), revision_surprise_low_extension +0.005 (0 chop trades), industry_stable_core_flow +0.054 (chop is its BEST bucket +$124/trade, matching the core stack +0.116 because the sleeve requires same-day core entry flow). Per-regime separation is the FGRS pattern: for chop-negative sleeves choppy_range is the ONLY losing bucket while risk_on_trend AND risk_off_stress stay strongly positive (sbc_burden: risk_on +$122/win65%, risk_off +$600/win90%, chop -$126/win22%). SCOPE decision for the sanctioned chop down-tilt: cover fiftytwo_week_high_proximity, supplier_financing_debt_relief, sbc_burden_improvement, turn_of_month_liquid_leadership (plus FGRS); distribution_day_absorption is borderline (negative Spearman but chop-bucket mean ~$0); EXCLUDE industry_stable_core_flow, narrow_range_compression (too few chop trades to size), revision_surprise (no chop trades), and the core stack. CAVEAT: observed_only -- the frozen-window counterfactual soft tilt CUTS PnL for every sleeve (-$148 to -$1,428) because these windows are net-positive, so the tilt cannot be proven by re-slicing; it needs forward entry-regime-tagged loss-making chop rows. Chop-bucket N per sleeve is small (2-23); Spearman uses continuous p_choppy over the full n=31-113 sample (robust statistic); magnitudes are indicative.

production_impact.parity_note: Read-only replay attribution of accepted default-off sleeve artifacts. No order/ranking/sizing/exit/Gate-4 change.
